trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an 18% error rate.

**Action taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed current production version v2.3.1 was unhealthy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Deployment history showed v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were healthy in production, while v2.3.1 (and its staging RC) were unhealthy.
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout completed successfully.
3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. (The first create attempt timed out; I retried with an idempotency key to avoid duplicates.)

**Verification:** Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Note:** The rollback itself did not require change-manager approval since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production (the policy only gates deploying versions that have never been healthy in production).
